milestones.outcome: The accepted Overview chip has one shared painter and the same treatment appears in Review, Comments and Appearance settings.
exit_criteria: Reference Open/All uses the shared surface painter without losing its accepted appearance or behavior.
Review and Comments choices/Reset plus Appearance tab choices use the same treatment; primary and specialized controls retain their meanings.
Four-theme focused rendering, interaction, disabled/focus/hover checks and relevant composed tests pass; record exact commands and platform limits.
milestones.boundary: Qt presentation and focused tests/docs only. This is the requested first implementation slice; remaining app migration is retained.

milestones.outcome: Comparable buttons throughout the app share the treatment and intentional variants are documented.
exit_criteria: Complete the RFC app-wide inventory with migrated or intentionally retained classifications.
Migrate remaining comparable text choices and secondary actions using the shared component and preserve primary/destructive/menu/icon variants.
Focused affected composition checks and representative actual renders pass.
milestones.boundary: Qt presentation, migration inventory, focused tests and documentation; preserve intentional variants and all command authority.

milestones.outcome: The entire migration has defensible visual and interaction evidence.
exit_criteria: Record RFC AC03–AC04 evidence at 1x, 1.25x and 2x across the four themes.
Record which native macOS/Windows/Linux behaviors were observed versus offscreen layout evidence; fix regressions rather than claim missing results.
Judge every RFC criterion against direct evidence, with the full migration inventory accounted for.
Documentation gate, focused integration and relevant formatting checks pass; retain native-platform limitations and obtain separate integration authorization.
milestones.boundary: Visual/interaction evidence, documentation and closeout proposal only; native evidence is never inferred and integration requires separate authorization.
